header.en: Finished reverse-engineering results: reimplemented engines, byte-matching decompilations, reimplemented formats, protocols, drivers and APIs, platform ports, compatibility patches.
header.zh: 已完成的逆向成果：重写的引擎、逐字节匹配的源码还原、重实现的格式/协议/驱动/API、平台移植、兼容性补丁。

header.en: This list catalogues **outcomes**, not instrumentation: the programs, formats and protocols people have actually taken apart and rebuilt. Entries are filed by the **kind of software** that was reconstructed, and inside `Games` by the **platform it originally ran on**. Each line states that platform — both ends for a port — and the method it was rebuilt by. Debuggers, decompilers, hex editors, trainers and similar tooling are out of scope; the tool lists are named under Related lists.
header.zh: 本清单收录的是**成果**而不是仪器：别人真的拆开并且真的重建了哪些程序、格式和协议。条目按**被重建的软件类型**归档；在「游戏」一节里再按**它原来跑在什么平台**上分二级。每一行都写明那个平台（移植会写两端）以及它是**用哪种方法**重建的。调试器、反编译器、十六进制编辑器、修改器一类工具不在范围内，工具清单见文末「相关清单」。

intro.en: Engines, decompiled binaries and recompiles of shipped games. Almost all of these leave the game files to the reader's own licensed copy; an entry that carries the original assets says so in its line.
intro.zh: 出货作品的引擎、反编译产物与重编译版本。这些几乎都不带游戏文件，素材由用户以自己的合法副本提供；确实内置原版素材的条目会在行里写明。

notes.en: `d2r-mobile` is neither emulation nor recompilation of assets: the game's own aarch64 program runs directly, and only the instructions that cannot execute under Apple's kernel are rewritten. Its target is the Switch build of Diablo II: Resurrected, 1.0.34.0, which equals the PC 3.3.94012 build. What was reverse engineered is the platform surface the game expects — syscalls, VFS, NVN reimplemented on Metal with shaders translated offline, audio, input. The repository ships no game content and lists its own RE output in `docs/DERIVED.md` (shader interface descriptions, graphics API function table, addresses inside the program); the user supplies their own dump via `nxdumptool`.
notes.zh: `d2r-mobile` 既不是模拟也不是重编译素材：游戏自己的 aarch64 程序直接执行，只有无法在苹果内核下运行的那部分指令被改写。它的目标是 Switch 版《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》1.0.34.0，与 PC 的 3.3.94012 版对应。真正被逆向的是游戏预期的平台接口面——系统调用、VFS、在 Metal 上重实现的 NVN（着色器离线转换）、音频、输入。仓库不含任何游戏内容，并在 `docs/DERIVED.md` 里逐项列出自己的逆向产出（着色器接口描述、图形 API 函数表、程序内地址）；素材由用户用自己的 dump 通过 `nxdumptool` 取得。

notes.en: The four Kirby entries above cover four Nintendo platforms and ship no ROM: `Kirby64Ret/kirby64` builds against a `baserom.us.z64` the reader supplies and tracks its decomp percentage, `jiangzhengwenjz/katam` targets the Game Boy Advance USA cartridge, `doldecomp/kar` the GameCube disc from the group behind the Super Smash Bros. Melee decompilation, `Swiftshine/key` the Wii USA release `RK5E01`. `Kirby64Ret/Kirby64Recomp` compiles the N64 image into a Windows, Linux and macOS program, and `ExpansionPak/ModernGekko` is the GameCube and Wii runtime such recomps load into.
notes.zh: 上面四部星之卡比作品覆盖四个任天堂平台，而且都不附带 ROM：`Kirby64Ret/kirby64` 要读者自己把 `baserom.us.z64` 放进树里才能构建，并跟踪自己的反编译百分比；`jiangzhengwenjz/katam` 针对 Game Boy Advance 美版卡带；`doldecomp/kar` 针对 GameCube 光盘，出自做 Super Smash Bros. Melee 反编译的那个组；`Swiftshine/key` 针对 Wii 美版发行 `RK5E01`。`Kirby64Ret/Kirby64Recomp` 把 N64 镜像编译成 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 程序，`ExpansionPak/ModernGekko` 则是这类重编译载入进去的 GameCube 与 Wii 运行时。

notes.en: The Super Mario 64 line is one reconstruction with several destinations: `n64decomp/sm64` builds the matching ROM from a `baserom.<VERSION>.z64`, `sm64-port/sm64-port` is the GitHub fork that adds native Linux and Windows targets, `sm64pc/sm64ex` forks that with enhancement packs and Emill's fast 3D renderer, and `coop-deluxe/sm64coopdx` continues the archived `djoslin0/sm64ex-coop` multiplayer mod on top of it. `HarbourMasters/Shipwright`, `2ship2harkinian/2ship2harkinian`, `HarbourMasters/SpaghettiKart` and `HarbourMasters/Starship` are one libultraship family — four titles, four ROM dumps, no shipped assets. Two of the decompilations state the boundary themselves: `zeldaret/tp` "is not, and will not, produce a port", which is the gap `TwilitRealm/dusklight` fills, and `SMGCommunity/Petari` refuses the port label outright; the Perfect Dark decompilation now lives on GitLab, with `n64decomp/perfect_dark` kept as a mirror.
notes.zh: Super Mario 64 这条线是一次重建、好几个去处：`n64decomp/sm64` 用读者提供的 `baserom.<VERSION>.z64` 构建出匹配的 ROM；`sm64-port/sm64-port` 是加上原生 Linux 与 Windows 目标的那个 GitHub fork；`sm64pc/sm64ex` 再 fork 一次，加入增强包与 Emill 的高速 3D 渲染器；`coop-deluxe/sm64coopdx` 在它上面接着做已归档的 `djoslin0/sm64ex-coop` 联机 mod。`HarbourMasters/Shipwright`、`2ship2harkinian/2ship2harkinian`、`HarbourMasters/SpaghettiKart` 与 `HarbourMasters/Starship` 属于同一个 libultraship 家族——四部作品、四份 ROM dump、不附带素材。两份反编译自己写明了边界：`zeldaret/tp` "is not, and will not, produce a port"，这段空缺正是 `TwilitRealm/dusklight` 补上的，而 `SMGCommunity/Petari` 直接拒绝"移植"这个标签。完美黑暗的反编译现在住在 GitLab，`n64decomp/perfect_dark` 只作为镜像保留。

notes.en: Four different reconstructions sit behind the PlayStation entries. `Xeeynamo/sotn-decomp` compiles back to the same bytes as the shipped binaries. `OpenDriver2/REDRIVER2` translates the MIPS code to C and runs it natively without emulation. `FelipePrado0/gow3_pc` and `deadinside28/bloodborne_pc` keep the original console code running and reimplement the system layer under it. `LoreanXavier/pt-pc` is the exception in that set: P.T.'s logic was rewritten from observed behaviour in a new engine that reads the original archives, so no original binary executes. `TeamGDB/Yakumo` is again a different shape: the PSP machine code is translated ahead of time into C++ and compiled for the host, so neither an interpreter nor the original binary runs, while the PSP system software underneath it is reimplemented. The Windows distribution of the Bloodborne port is carried by the fork `Supermedo/bloodborne_pc`, whose contributor list includes the upstream author.
notes.zh: PlayStation 这一节背后是四种不同的重建。`Xeeynamo/sotn-decomp` 编译回去的字节和出货二进制一样。`OpenDriver2/REDRIVER2` 把 MIPS 代码翻成 C 并原生运行，不经过模拟。`FelipePrado0/gow3_pc` 与 `deadinside28/bloodborne_pc` 让原版主机代码继续执行，重建的是它底下的那一层系统。`LoreanXavier/pt-pc` 是这组里的例外：P.T. 的逻辑是按观测到的行为在新引擎里重写的，由新引擎去读原版归档，没有任何原版二进制在跑。`TeamGDB/Yakumo` 又是另一种形态：PSP 机器码被提前翻译成 C++ 并编译成宿主机程序，既没有解释器也没有原版二进制在运行，重建的是它底下的 PSP 系统软件。血源诅咒这个移植的 Windows 发行由 fork `Supermedo/bloodborne_pc` 承担，它的贡献者列表里包含上游作者。

notes.en: `xsystem4` keeps a public `game_compatibility.md`: 66 titles, 41 supported, 18 unknown, 7 unsupported, with 戦国ランス / Sengoku Rance, Rance VI, Rance 01 and Rance 02 marked supported and ランス・クエスト unsupported. The same author also maintains `xsystem35-sdl2`, `xsystem4-android`, `xsys35c` (under Formats, file systems and protocols), `system3-sdl2`, `sys4lang` and `libsys4`.
notes.zh: `xsystem4` 带一份公开的 `game_compatibility.md`：66 部作品，41 支持、18 未知、7 不支持，其中 戦国ランス / Sengoku Rance、Rance VI、Rance 01、Rance 02 标为支持，ランス・クエスト 标为不支持。同一作者还维护 `xsystem35-sdl2`、`xsystem4-android`、`xsys35c`（见下文「格式、文件系统与协议」）、`system3-sdl2`、`sys4lang` 和 `libsys4`。

notes.en: `mytbk/rich4` pins its target: `rich4.exe` v3.11, 588 KiB, SHA-256 `5a90aee28ee5f7a5c3ba5cb935c9e55751a529c25fcd91208748a66293569550`. Three months of work in 2018 produced the data-file unpacking algorithm and the save format; in 2021 the executable became re-linkable assembly via `mytbk/r2dumpbin`; in 2025 the Watcom C runtime was stripped far enough that MinGW and `msvcrt` link a runnable `rich4.exe`. The annotated split lives in `vimacs/rich4_asm` on Codeberg, and `tytannial/rich4-re` is a third attempt at the same title. `lhr0909/richman4-remastered` states in its own acknowledgements that every rule, screen and animation timing was rewritten against that published disassembly; the Steam release of 《大富翁4》 supplies the assets.
notes.zh: `mytbk/rich4` 把自己的目标钉得很死：`rich4.exe` v3.11、588 KiB，SHA-256 `5a90aee28ee5f7a5c3ba5cb935c9e55751a529c25fcd91208748a66293569550`。2018 年三个月的工作做出了数据文件的解包算法与存档格式；2021 年借助 `mytbk/r2dumpbin` 把可执行文件变成可重新链接的汇编；2025 年 Watcom C 运行时被剥离到 MinGW 与 `msvcrt` 能链接出可运行的 `rich4.exe`。带注释的拆分放在 Codeberg 上的 `vimacs/rich4_asm`，`tytannial/rich4-re` 是同一部作品的第三个尝试。`lhr0909/richman4-remastered` 在自己的致谢里写明：每条规则、每个界面与动画时序都是照着那份公开反汇编重写的；素材来自 Steam 上架的《大富翁4》。

notes.en: The Diablo line has three destinations and one origin: `diasurgical/devilution` reconstructed the 1996 code from the symbol file the Climax PlayStation port left behind and from a debug build hidden inside `DIABDAT.MPQ` as `D1221A.MPQ`, and it deliberately keeps the original bugs; `diasurgical/DevilutionX` is the SDL port of that reconstruction to about a dozen platforms; `d07RiV/diabloweb` builds a forked devilution to WebAssembly for browsers. All three carry the Sustainable Use License, the non-commercial licence GitHub reports as `NOASSERTION`. `wheybags/freeablo` reimplements the same engine by another route and needs `Diablo.exe` as well as the MPQ. Caesar III has the same fork relationship: `Keriew/augustus` is the fork of `bvschaik/julius` that adds gameplay changes and gives up the two-way save compatibility Julius holds to. The Fallout community editions state their own method chain — each is built on the author's matching reverse-engineered base rather than on any Interplay or Bethesda source release.
notes.zh: 暗黑破坏神这条线是一个起点、三个去处：`diasurgical/devilution` 从 Climax 的 PlayStation 移植留下的符号文件、以及藏在 `DIABDAT.MPQ` 里名为 `D1221A.MPQ` 的调试构建，重建出 1996 年的代码，并且刻意保留原版的 bug；`diasurgical/DevilutionX` 是这份重建的 SDL 移植，覆盖十几个平台；`d07RiV/diabloweb` 把 fork 过的 devilution 构建成浏览器里跑的 WebAssembly。三者的许可证都是 Sustainable Use License，也就是 GitHub 报成 `NOASSERTION` 的非商用许可证。凯撒大帝 III 也是同样的 fork 关系：`Keriew/augustus` 是 `bvschaik/julius` 的 fork，加了玩法改动，代价是放弃 Julius 一直坚持的双向存档兼容。辐射社区版写明了自己的方法链——每一个都建立在作者自己匹配出来的逆向底子上，而不是 Interplay 或 Bethesda 放出的源码。

intro.zh: 不是游戏、但重建到能吃原版内容的程序。

intro.en: The platform the program expects, rebuilt or shimmed: an API, a firmware interface, a runtime, an emulator, or the patch that unblocks one title on a new host.
intro.zh: 程序所预期的那一层平台被重建或被垫片化：一个 API、一个固件接口、一个运行时、一台模拟器，或者让某部作品在新宿主上跑起来的补丁。

notes.en: Wine codepage gap: Wine 10.0 ships 76 `.nls` codepage tables, and GB18030 (`c_54936.nls`) is not one of them, so a Simplified-Chinese title that calls `MultiByteToWideChar(54936, …)` during process init hangs with no window. Two fixes exist: add the missing table to the prefix (under Proton it must land in `syswow64`, because Wine redirects a 32-bit process's `system32` lookups), or patch the executable to request CP936. ⚠ *Substituting the GBK table loses GB18030's 4-byte sequences, so either route is an approximation; what differs between them is invasiveness, not correctness.*
notes.zh: Wine 的代码页缺口：Wine 10.0 自带 76 个 `.nls` 代码页表，GB18030（`c_54936.nls`）不在其中，所以一个在进程初始化时调用 `MultiByteToWideChar(54936, …)` 的简体中文作品会不开窗口地卡死。两种修法：把缺的表补进 prefix（在 Proton 下必须放进 `syswow64`，因为 Wine 自己会把 32 位进程对 `system32` 的查询重定向），或者改可执行文件让它请求 CP936。⚠ *换成 GBK 表都会丢掉 GB18030 的 4 字节序列，因此两条路都是近似；两者的实际区别是侵入程度，不是正确性。*

intro.en: File formats, file systems and network protocols reimplemented from observation, with no original implementation shipped.
intro.zh: 靠观测重实现的二进制格式、文件系统与网络协议，不附带原版实现。

notes.en: LibreDWG is GPL-3, which is incompatible with the LGPL downstreams that would adopt it: a finished format reconstruction that its own ecosystem cannot absorb.
notes.zh: LibreDWG 是 GPL-3，与本应采用它的 LGPL 下游不兼容：一个技术上已经完成的格式重建，自己的生态却吸收不了。

intro.en: This list takes results only; these take tools or a wider net.
intro.zh: 本清单只收成果，下面这些收工具或撒更大的网。

intro.en: Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to add an entry, and `INTAKE.md` and `AGENTS.md` for how the list is classified, sourced and refreshed. The rules that decide most PRs: **file the entry under the kind of software it reconstructed, name the original platform and the method**, because "cool project, you should look at it" is not an entry; and **unverified claims get a ⚠ or stay out** — name the primary source you actually read, or write what you could not read.
intro.zh: 新增条目的规则见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，清单如何分类、核验与刷新写在 `INTAKE.md` 与 `AGENTS.md`。决定大多数 PR 的两条：**按它重建的是哪一类软件归档，写明原始平台与重建方法**，"这个项目很牛，值得看"不构成一条条目；**核不实的说法加 ⚠，或者不写**——写出你真的读过的一手来源，或者写出你没读到什么。

desc.zh: 毁灭公爵 II，MS-DOS → Windows、Linux、macOS、Steam Deck 与树莓派，自述"based on reverse engineering (specifically, disassembly of the original binaries)"

desc.en: Sonic Mania (2017), the game code around Retro Engine v5, self-described "a complete decompilation" that will not run without the assets from the official releases
desc.zh: Sonic Mania（2017），Retro Engine v5 周围的游戏代码，自述"a complete decompilation"，没有官方发行版的素材就跑不起来

note.en: Its README adds a built-in mod loader and API calls on top of the decompilation.
note.zh: 它的 README 说明反编译之上另加了内置 mod 加载器与 API 调用。

admission.a1: Sonic Mania (2017) ships as a retail binary from Sega; the repository's README opens by asking readers to support the official release and states the decompilation will not run without its assets, so the source of what was decompiled has not been released.
admission.a2_quote: A complete decompilation of Sonic Mania (2017)
admission.a3: 1,314 paths, 612 .c and 616 .h in the tree itself, plus Game/, SonicMania.sln, an Xcode project and a Switch icon; the engine arrives as the RSDKv5 submodule, which is why the README insists on a recursive clone.

desc.en: Retro Engine v3, the engine of the 2011 Sonic CD re-release, "A complete decompilation" that will not run without the official release's assets, with Windows, iOS/macOS, Android, UWP and PS Vita build files
desc.zh: Retro Engine v3，2011 年索尼克 CD 重制版所用的引擎，自述"A complete decompilation"，没有官方发行版的素材就跑不起来，树中含 Windows、iOS/macOS、Android、UWP 与 PS Vita 构建文件

note.en: Its FAQ lists the ports of this engine decompilation maintained by other teams.
note.zh: 它的 FAQ 列出了其他团队维护的该引擎反编译移植。

admission.a1: The 2011 Sonic CD re-release ships as a retail binary; its README asks readers to support the official release and states the decompilation will not run without its assets, so the engine's source has not been released by its rights holder.
admission.a2_quote: A complete decompilation of Retro Engine v3.
admission.a3: 259 paths holding the engine as C++/.hpp/.cpp under RSDKv3/, with Android.mk, an Xcode project, a UWP solution and a Vita project beside CMakeLists.txt; the .java files are the Android build glue.

desc.en: Three's Company full-motion-video game engine, MS-DOS, clean-room
desc.zh: Three's Company 全动态影像游戏的引擎，MS-DOS，净室重写

desc.en: Ultima VII engine, MS-DOS and Macintosh
desc.zh: 创世纪 VII 引擎，MS-DOS 与 Macintosh

desc.en: Tyrian engine, MS-DOS
desc.zh: Tyrian 引擎，MS-DOS

desc.en: Retro Engine v5 and v5Ultimate, the engine behind Sonic Mania, "A complete decompilation of Retro Engine v5 and v5Ultimate", whose README disclaims ownership and names the engine's current owner
desc.zh: Retro Engine v5 与 v5Ultimate，Sonic Mania 背后的引擎，自述"A complete decompilation of Retro Engine v5 and v5Ultimate"，其 README 声明自己不拥有该引擎并写出它现在的所有者

note.en: Its FAQ says the team is "done with decompiling, at least for the time being".
note.zh: 它的 FAQ 称该团队"done with decompiling, at least for the time being"。

admission.a1: Retro Engine v5(U) ships inside retail games only; the README states "We do not own the Retro Engine in any way, shape or form" and names Evening Star as its current owner, and forbids using the project to pirate the games, so no released source underlies it.
admission.a2_quote: A complete decompilation of Retro Engine v5 and v5Ultimate.
admission.a3: 501 paths holding the engine as 105 .hpp and 103 .cpp in RSDKv5/ and RSDKv5U/, with two solutions, two Xcode projects and an Android directory; the README carries no separate asset-boundary sentence, so reader-supplied rests on it being the engine of games it does not ship (its own piracy line names them).

desc.en: Cave Story engine, Windows, clean-room
desc.zh: Cave Story 引擎，Windows，净室重写

desc.en: One Must Fall 2097 by Diversions Entertainment, MS-DOS 1994 → Windows, Linux, macOS and BSD, engine remake started because the original's IPX networking "is a pain to set up", on the reader's own game resources
desc.zh: Diversions Entertainment 的 One Must Fall 2097，MS-DOS 1994 → Windows、Linux、macOS 与 BSD，起因是原版 IPX 联网"is a pain to set up"的引擎重制，跑读者自备的原版游戏资源

admission.a1: OMF 2097 shipped for DOS in 1994 and Diversions never released its source; the README names that shipped game as the target and the reason it exists.
admission.a2_quote: OpenOMF is an Open Source remake of "One Must Fall 2097" by Diversions Entertainment.
admission.a2_read_at: README.md head#5-6, 2026-10-17 (one sentence wrapped across two lines)
admission.a3: src/ with 245 .c and 231 .h, CMakeLists.txt and CI workflows; the tree ships no original data — PATHS.md, read 2026-10-17, defines the resource path as "for original game resources and additional OpenOMF resources (read-only)".

desc.en: Total Annihilation engine, Windows → Linux, Windows, macOS and the browser, reimplemented in Go on Ebitengine with its file-format and behaviour research published in the tree
desc.zh: Total Annihilation 引擎，Windows → Linux、Windows、macOS 与浏览器，用 Go 在 Ebitengine 上重建，格式与行为研究文档一并放在仓库里

note.en: Its README states the engine is still in beta, and its NOTICE bars retail source code and extracted game art from the repository.
note.zh: 它的 README 自述引擎仍在 beta 阶段，NOTICE 则禁止提交原版程序代码与提取出的游戏美术。

admission.a1: Reimplemented from the retail Total Annihilation behaviour and file formats; the original engine's source was not published
admission.a2_quote: Its current focus is a clean-room reimplementation of Total Annihilation.
admission.a3: internal/ 3,237 and cmd/ 661 Go files, with formats/ 59 and vfs/ 22; no gitlinks in the tree

desc.en: Touhou 8: Imperishable Night, Windows: the Japanese 1.00d executable reconstructed to C++ to reproduce "its machine code, binary interfaces, and executable layout" on the original Visual C++ .NET 2002 toolchain
desc.zh: 东方8 永夜抄，Windows：把日文版 1.00d 可执行文件重建为 C++，用原版 Visual C++ .NET 2002 工具链复现 "its machine code, binary interfaces, and executable layout"

note.en: Its README says AI coding agents carry out the reverse engineering, matching, semantic recovery, tooling, documentation and porting in this continuation of the GensokyoClub work.
note.zh: 它的 README 写道，这次接续 GensokyoClub 的工作由 AI 编码代理承担逆向、比对、语义恢复、工具、文档与移植。

admission.a1: Reconstructed from the legally obtained Japanese TH08 1.00d executable; Team Shanghai Alice has not published its source
admission.a2_quote: Our goal is an exact reconstruction of the original Japanese TH08 1.00d executable: recover C++ that, with the original Visual C++ .NET 2002 toolchain, reproduces its machine code, binary interfaces, and executable layout.
admission.a3: src/ 116 C++ and header files plus scripts/ 84; the only gitlink is 3rdparty/Detours

desc.en: The Binding of Isaac, Windows Flash → Windows, Linux, Android and Nintendo Switch, static recompilation of the AVM1 code into C++ on an engine written from scratch, reading graphics, sound and music from the player's own Steam Isaac.exe
desc.zh: 《以撒的结合》，Windows Flash → Windows、Linux、Android 与任天堂 Switch，把 AVM1 代码静态重编译为 C++ 并跑在从零写成的引擎上，图像、音效与音乐读取玩家自备的 Steam 版 Isaac.exe

note.en: Its README states the Flash Player 8 semantics are ported from Ruffle and names JPEXS as the decompiler its tooling uses.
note.zh: 它的 README 写道 Flash Player 8 语义取自 Ruffle 的移植，并列出工具链使用 JPEXS 反编译器。

admission.a1: Recompiled from the shipped Flash game's AVM1 code; the developer never published it
admission.a2_quote: This project translates all of the game's original code into C++ and runs it on a modern, native engine written from scratch.
admission.a3: gen/ and gen720/ 86 generated C++ files plus rt/ 26 runtime files and tools/; no gitlinks in the tree

desc.en: Touhou 9.5: Shoot the Bullet, Windows: the Japanese 1.02a executable reconstructed to C++, where its exact totals count only functions whose pinned VC7.1 unit passes the project's zero-difference comparator
desc.zh: 东方9.5 文花帖，Windows：把日文版 1.02a 可执行文件重建为 C++，其 exact 计数只认在钉定的 VC7.1 编译下通过零差异比对的函数

note.en: Its README states that all confirmed authored functions have reconstructed source and the reconstructed Windows i386 build is playable.
note.zh: 它的 README 写道，所有已确认的原作函数都已重建出源码，重建出的 Windows i386 版本可以游玩。

admission.a1: Reconstructed from the legally obtained Japanese TH095 1.02a executable; no vendor source exists
admission.a2_quote: Exact totals count only functions whose configured VC7.1 unit passes the canonical zero-difference comparator and is recorded consistently in both config/matches.csv and config/functions.csv.
admission.a3: src/ 196 files, 108 .hpp and 88 .cpp; no gitlinks in the tree

desc.en: Sonic the Hedgehog (1991), the 16-bit Mega Drive/Genesis cartridge disassembled to 455 .asm files that assemble back into a ROM
desc.zh: Sonic the Hedgehog（1991），16 位 Mega Drive/Genesis 卡带的反汇编，455 个 .asm 文件可重新装配成 ROM

admission.a1: Sega shipped Sonic the Hedgehog (1991) as a Mega Drive/Genesis cartridge and never released its source; the repository is the disassembly itself, and --has found no original ROM committed in its tree (0/11 candidate names), so the code and data are all recovered rather than supplied.
admission.a2_quote: # Sonic the Hedgehog (16-bit) Disassembly
admission.a3: 1,009 paths holding 455 .asm across the ROM's own sections (_incObj 136, _maps 132, sound 70, _anim 49, _inc 33), no submodule and no external repository link, so the reconstruction is this tree and not a pointer.

desc.en: Jazz Jackrabbit engine, MS-DOS
desc.zh: Jazz Jackrabbit 引擎，MS-DOS

desc.en: Dune 2 by Westwood Studios, MS-DOS → Windows, Linux and macOS, SDL3 remake that carries its own campaign, map and shader resources in the tree and adds skirmish play, zooming and higher resolutions
desc.zh: Westwood Studios 的 Dune 2，MS-DOS → Windows、Linux 与 macOS，基于 SDL3 的重制，仓库自带战役、地图与着色器资源，另加遭遇战、缩放与更高分辨率

admission.a1: Dune 2 (1992) was shipped for MS-DOS by Westwood; nothing in the README's 114 lines or the 916-path tree claims vendor source, and the project's own copyright line runs to the author.
admission.a2_quote: A.k.a. D2TM. Is a [Dune 2](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dune_II) remake.
admission.a3: src/ in 194 .cpp and 211 .h with Catch2 tests built alongside as d2tm_tests; resources/bin holds 431 project-authored paths (per-mission .ini campaigns, .map files, .hlsl shaders) and no original Dune 2 data files.

desc.en: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (1992), the 16-bit Mega Drive/Genesis cartridge disassembled to 332 .asm files that assemble back into a ROM
desc.zh: Sonic the Hedgehog 2（1992），16 位 Mega Drive/Genesis 卡带的反汇编，332 个 .asm 文件可重新装配成 ROM

note.en: Its README says the built ROM is named 's2built.bin'.
note.zh: 它的 README 说明构建出的 ROM 名为 's2built.bin'。

admission.a1: Sega shipped Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (1992) as a Mega Drive/Genesis cartridge and never released its source; the README's own build line states "The built ROM will be called 's2built.bin'", and --has found no original ROM committed in the tree (0/11 candidate names), so nothing external is required to rebuild it.
admission.a2_quote: # Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (16-bit) Disassembly
admission.a3: 1,140 paths holding 332 .asm, concentrated in the ROM's own data sections (mappings 211, sound 113) with the master s2.asm at the root, plus build_tools 16 of C/.h/.lua and SonLVL editor INI helpers; no submodule, no external repository link, and no committed original ROM.

desc.en: 《仙剑奇侠传》 (PAL, Softstar, 1995), DOS and Windows → the browser, written from scratch in TypeScript with its own MKF extractor, script virtual machine, palette renderer and visual editor
desc.zh: 软星的《仙剑奇侠传》，1995，DOS 与 Windows → 浏览器，以 TypeScript 从零写成，自带 MKF 解包、脚本虚拟机、调色板渲染与可视化编辑器

note.en: It keeps a copy of sdlpal's C source in reference/ as a specification only, and says plainly that the committed demo still holds a little PAL-derived art that is not cleared for release.
note.zh: reference/ 里保留 sdlpal 的 C 源码只作参考规格；仓库自述已入库的 demo 仍含少量 PAL 派生素材，尚未完成版权清理。

admission.a1: A shipped 1995 DOS title; the README states 与大宇、软星以及《仙剑奇侠传》的权利人无关，未获官方授权或认可 — an unofficial reconstruction with no vendor source, and it names 原版数据和行为 as the primary source of truth.
admission.a2_quote: 用 TypeScript 从零写成的浏览器版《仙剑奇侠传》（1995，亦称 PAL）：第一阶段可以在线玩到结局，第二阶段在做新运行时和可视化编辑器。
admission.a2_read_at: README.md head#3, 2026-10-17 (README.md is the Chinese README; README.en.md mirrors it)
admission.a3: 2,100 .ts sources in packages/game, pal-extract, shared, content and migrate — the runtime and the editor, not a loader; reference/sdlpal is a C reference copy and the README says the extraction, VM, rendering, combat and editor are all TypeScript (head#50).

desc.en: The Settlers I by BlueByte, DOS and Amiga → Windows, Linux, macOS and Android, C# remake written as a port and extension of the freeserf clone, with added AI and local-network play, on the reader's original data files
desc.zh: BlueByte 的 The Settlers I，DOS 与 Amiga → Windows、Linux、macOS 与 Android，以 C# 移植并扩展 freeserf 克隆，另加 AI 与局域网对战，跑读者手中原版数据

admission.a1: The Settlers I was shipped by BlueByte and its source was never released; the upstream it ports, freeserf, is itself a community reconstruction rather than vendor code, and the README is explicit that all of its code was ported or re-implemented from that.
admission.a2_quote: Freeserf.net is an authentic remake of the game **The Settlers I** by BlueByte.
admission.a3: Freeserf.Core, Renderer, Audio and Network projects, 221 .cs files — the engine itself; the README's own boundary line: "To avoid copyright issues I won't provide any copyrighted data from the original game like music or graphics" (head#3).

desc.en: Magic Carpet 2, MS-DOS → Windows and Linux, rebuilt from the shipped assembler into C/C++ and continued from the reverse engineering it credits, with a regression test suite and its own enhanced asset set
desc.zh: Magic Carpet 2，MS-DOS → Windows 与 Linux，从出货汇编重建成 C/C++，并接续它所署名的那份逆向工作，带回归测试与自制高清素材

admission.a1: A shipped Bullfrog DOS binary taken apart from assembler; the README's footer records "Original Source Code is Copyright 1995 Bullfrog Productions" as a copyright note, not as access — the work is described as recovered from the machine code.
admission.a2_quote: Based off the Reverse engineering of game Magic Carpet 2 from assembler to c/c++ language by Tomas Versly
admission.a2_read_at:
README.md head#2, 2026-10-17 (verbatim, including the trailing
and the misspelling of Tomas Vesely's name)
admission.a3: src/ in 219 .h, 166 .cpp and 30 .c with CMake, sanitiser options and CI, plus remc2-regression-test; the 5,367 enhancedassets paths are the project's own upscaled art. Boundary read at head#36: "Anyone with the GOG edition can download this repo, extract the Game Assets (from a legal GOG copy of the game) and run it."

desc.en: Richman 4 (大富翁4), Windows, disassembly that re-links against MinGW and `msvcrt` into a runnable `rich4.exe`
desc.zh: 大富翁4，Windows，反汇编之后改用 MinGW 与 `msvcrt` 重新链接成可运行的 `rich4.exe`

desc.zh: 把 WarCraft 1 做成建立在 Wargus 上的即时战略引擎，MS-DOS 与 Windows

desc.en: Slay the Spire 2, Steam Windows and Linux build → iOS, "bring your own Steam copy"
desc.zh: 杀戮尖塔 2，Steam 的 Windows/Linux 构建 → iOS，"自带 Steam 副本"

desc.en: DX-Ball, MS-DOS: the 1996 shareware `DXBALL.EXE` reconstructed to C and C++, "exact reconstruction is in progress"
desc.zh: DX-Ball，MS-DOS：1996 年的共享软件 `DXBALL.EXE` 重建为 C 与 C++，自述"完全重建仍在进行"

note.en: A post claims a Steam build runs; the repository does not say so.
note.zh: 有帖子声称 Steam 版能跑，仓库里并没有这么写。

desc.en: Touhou 4, Windows: `MAIN.EXE` reconstructed to C++, with "2,139 matching bytes" claimed against the original
desc.zh: 东方 4，Windows：`MAIN.EXE` 重建为 C++，自述与原程序有 2,139 个逐字节匹配

desc.en: Emperor: Rise of the Middle Kingdom, real-time strategy, Windows → Apple Silicon macOS, clean-room reimplementation in C++20 and SDL3 that reads the original game files the player supplies and bundles no original assets
desc.zh: 《Emperor: Rise of the Middle Kingdom》，即时战略，Windows → Apple Silicon macOS，用 C++20 与 SDL3 的净室重写，读取玩家提供的原版游戏文件，不打包任何原始素材

note.en: Early development by its own description, and its documentation separates observed source facts, supported interpretation and authored preview behaviour — the map format and graphics IDs are recorded there as reverse-engineering evidence.
note.zh: 按其自身描述仍属早期开发；文档区分观察到的源码事实、有依据的推断与自己写的预览行为——地图格式与图形 ID 就是作为逆向证据记录在其中的。

admission.a1: Sierra's Emperor: Rise of the Middle Kingdom is a shipped commercial game whose source has never been released; the candidate's own licence file is custom (GitHub reports NOASSERTION, so no licence is claimed in the line) and it states original assets and decoded images are never bundled — an independent implementation, not vendor-released source.
admission.a2_quote: Clean-room reimplementation of Emperor: Rise of the Middle Kingdom in C++20 and SDL3. Built for modern systems, starting with Apple Silicon macOS. Early development; original game data required.
admission.a3: 707 paths, 288 .cpp and 127 .h under src/, with tests/, tools/ and a 173-file docs/ tree carrying the reverse-engineering evidence — the reconstruction is in the linked repository.

desc.en: Richman 4 (大富翁4), Windows → macOS, Android and iOS, engine rewritten rule by rule against `mytbk/rich4`'s published disassembly rather than clean-room
desc.zh: 大富翁4，Windows → macOS、Android、iOS，引擎按 `mytbk/rich4` 公开的反汇编逐条重写，不是净室

note.en: Its NOTICE limits a built APK to the builder's own devices.
note.zh: 它的 NOTICE 把编译出的 APK 限制在构建者自己的设备上。

desc.en: Ultima V: Warriors of Destiny, MS-DOS → Windows, macOS and Linux, Go recreation that reads the player's own game files, keeps SAVED.GAM save compatibility through a command-line converter, and ships a developer Debug Workbench
desc.zh: Ultima V: Warriors of Destiny，MS-DOS → Windows、macOS 与 Linux，以 Go 重建，读取玩家自备的原版文件，用命令行转换器保持 SAVED.GAM 存档兼容，并带开发者 Debug Workbench

admission.a1: Ultima V is a shipped MS-DOS title; the README calls the project "a free, non-commercial fan project" whose project-authored source is its own, and states the game does not download original assets for you.
admission.a2_quote: A modern Go recreation of **Ultima V: Warriors of Destiny**, with enhanced presentation, quality-of-life improvements, and a developer Debug Workbench.
admission.a2_read_at: README.md head#4-5, 2026-10-17 (one sentence wrapped across two lines)
admission.a3: 2,346 .go files under internal/ and pkg/ with a Makefile and golangci CI; data/ holds 35 project-authored paths and no original game files.

desc.en: AliceSoft System 4 visual novels, Windows titles rebuilt for unix-like systems
desc.zh: AliceSoft System 4 视觉小说，把 Windows 上的作品重建到类 unix 系统

desc.en: 《三國演義》 (Softworld, 1991), MS-DOS → Windows, Linux and macOS, engine rewritten in Go and Ebiten against the original's verifiable behaviour, keeping the confirmed rule differences of both releases, needs the reader's own game data
desc.zh: 智冠的《三國演義》，1991，MS-DOS → Windows、Linux 与 macOS，引擎以 Go 与 Ebiten 按原版可查证的表现重写，保留两个版本已确认的规则差异，需读者自备原版数据

note.en: Rule restoration is signed off differentially: the project's own headless DOS runner executes the original executable and the remake is compared against variables and calls read out of it.
note.zh: 它的规则验收是对拍：由项目自己的无头 DOS 执行器跑原版执行档，再拿读出的原版变量与调用逐项比对。

admission.a1: README's own provenance sentence: 智冠科技於 1991 年推出的 DOS 策略遊戲《三國演義》 — a shipped title, and Softworld has released no source for it.
admission.a2_quote: 引擎以 Go／Ebiten 重寫，支援原版及《三國演義1加強版》，依據能夠查證的原版表現重現核心玩法，並保留兩個版本已確認的規則差異。
admission.a3: cmd/san1 and cmd/san1assets hold the Go engine; docs/formats holds the container-format documents and docs/playtest the differential-run records.

note.zh: 它的 README 写着"an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop, rebuilt in pure Rust"，因此按净室成果归档。

admission.a2_quote: Image editing; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop, rebuilt in pure Rust.

desc.en: Adobe Flash Player, AVM2 plus rendering, Rust, clean-room
desc.zh: Adobe Flash Player，AVM2 加渲染，Rust，净室重写

desc.en: Microsoft Word for Windows and Mac, consuming the original document formats, Rust
desc.zh: 面向 Windows 与 Mac 的 Microsoft Word，直接吃原版文档格式，Rust

note.en: Its README states "Clean-room: built from public specifications and observation, with every asset original or openly licensed", so it is filed as clean-room work.
note.zh: 它的 README 写着"Clean-room: built from public specifications and observation, with every asset original or openly licensed"，因此按净室成果归档。

desc.en: Microsoft Excel, rebuilt clean-room in Rust with XLSX as its native format and XLSB and ODS worksheet data import
desc.zh: 净室用 Rust 重写的 Microsoft Excel，以 XLSX 为原生格式，可导入 XLSB 与 ODS 工作表数据

admission.a1: Excel is a shipped Microsoft product whose source Microsoft has not released; the README's own mark line states Microsoft, Excel and Microsoft 365 are Microsoft's trademarks while GridCraft is independent and unaffiliated.
admission.a2_quote: Spreadsheets and data; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Excel, rebuilt in pure Rust.
admission.a3: 499 paths, 285 .rs — the README's own layer table names the crates it is built from (core, numfmt, formula, functions, model, calc, xlsx, chart, engine, ui-egui, mcp) with apps/gridcraft, apps/gridcraft-cli and apps/gridcraft-web above them.

desc.en: Autodesk AutoCAD, rebuilt clean-room in Rust: the command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and DXF drawings
desc.zh: 净室用 Rust 重写的 Autodesk AutoCAD：命令行、对象捕捉、图层、标注、填充、块与 DXF 图纸

note.en: Its README names the boundary itself: SHX fonts, including big fonts such as chineset.shx, are not read yet, so SHX-styled text is drawn with the project's own stroke font.
note.zh: 边界由它的 README 自己写明：SHX 字体（含 chineset.shx 这类大字体）尚未读取，SHX 样式的文字改用项目自带的笔画字体。

admission.a1: AutoCAD is a shipped Autodesk product with no released source; the README states the names are used only to describe the workflows and file formats it is compatible with, and that CADCraft is independent, unaffiliated and unendorsed.
admission.a2_quote: Computer-aided design and drafting; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Autodesk AutoCAD, rebuilt in pure Rust.
admission.a3: 819 paths, 579 .rs — examples/apartment.dxf is drawn by CADCraft's own commands and cadcraft-cli reads a DXF and converts it to SVG, so the reader and the writer are in this repository.

desc.en: Microsoft PowerPoint, rebuilt clean-room in Rust: opens and saves .pptx, exports PDF, PNG/JPEG and an animated GIF of the deck
desc.zh: 净室用 Rust 重写的 Microsoft PowerPoint：可打开与保存 .pptx，导出 PDF、PNG/JPEG 与整份演示的 GIF 动画

note.en: The repository publishes its own unfinished state: it calls itself alpha heading for beta, and ROADMAP.md, docs/target-app-parity.md, docs/gaps.md and docs/parity-checklist.md carry the assessment.
note.zh: 仓库自己公布未完工的部分：README 称其为迈向 beta 的 alpha 版，ROADMAP.md、docs/target-app-parity.md、docs/gaps.md 与 docs/parity-checklist.md 给出分区评估。

admission.a1: Microsoft PowerPoint is a shipped commercial product whose source Microsoft has not released; the repository carries its own LICENSE-APACHE, LICENSE-MIT, NOTICE and ATTRIBUTION.md, and states that bundled fonts, icons and images keep their own open licences and are listed there by author, source and licence — an independent implementation, not vendor-released source.
admission.a2_quote: Presentations and slide shows; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft PowerPoint, rebuilt in pure Rust.
admission.a3: 686 paths, 417 .rs, with apps/ and crates/ at the root and crates/pdf named as a component in its own README — the reconstruction is in the linked repository.

desc.en: Avid Pro Tools, rebuilt clean-room in Rust as a multitrack DAW with fader automation, a MIDI score editor and MusicXML export
desc.zh: 净室用 Rust 重写的 Avid Pro Tools，作多轨音频工作站，带推子自动化、MIDI 音色编辑器与 MusicXML 导出

note.en: Parity with the target app is measured in the open: docs/target-app-parity.md holds the assessment and docs/parity-checklist.md compares the two menu by menu.
note.zh: 它与原版的对齐是公开量出来的：docs/target-app-parity.md 是评估，docs/parity-checklist.md 逐菜单对照。

admission.a1: Pro Tools is a shipped Avid product with no released source; the README states Avid and Pro Tools are Avid Technology's trademarks while SoundCraft is independent and unaffiliated.
admission.a2_quote: Recording, editing and mixing audio; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Avid Pro Tools, rebuilt in pure Rust.
admission.a3: 525 paths, 299 .rs — soundcraft-model is the session document and soundcraft-engine the commands, undo, editing, import/export and bounce, with the app in apps/soundcraft; the tree's 35 asset files are the project's own, listed with author and licence in ATTRIBUTION.md.

desc.en: Figma, rebuilt clean-room in Rust: SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP and PDF in and out, .fig files opened best-effort
desc.zh: 净室用 Rust 重写的 Figma：可进出 SVG、PNG、JPG、WebP 与 PDF，尽力打开 .fig 文件

note.en: Its own boundary statement is explicit — no proprietary code, file formats, icons or images, every icon drawn in code or made for the project — and the area-by-area picture is left to the roadmap and docs/target-app-parity.md.
note.zh: 它自己划的边界很清楚：不含专有代码、文件格式、图标或图片，每个图标都由代码绘制或为本项目制作；分区进度交给 roadmap 与 docs/target-app-parity.md。

admission.a1: Figma is a shipped commercial product whose application source Figma has not released; the repository carries LICENSE-APACHE, LICENSE-MIT, NOTICE and ATTRIBUTION.md and its README states plainly that no proprietary code, file formats, icons or images are used — an independent implementation, not vendor-released source.
admission.a2_quote: Interface design; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Figma, rebuilt in pure Rust.
admission.a3: 1,029 paths, 715 .rs, with apps/ and crates/ at the root and docs/control-protocol.md, docs/mcp.md and docs/cli.md describing what it implements — the reconstruction is in the linked repository.

desc.en: Tencent's QQ Pet desktop client, Windows → Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, HarmonyOS and iOS, rebuilt from the Arctic Penguin T800 client, with its Flash content played by Ruffle
desc.zh: 腾讯 QQ 宠物桌面客户端，Windows → Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、HarmonyOS 与 iOS，基于 Arctic Penguin T800 版本重建，Flash 内容交由 Ruffle 播放

note.en: Its repository description names AI as the author of the recreation.
note.zh: 它的仓库描述里注明这份复刻出自 AI。

admission.a1: Rebuilt from Tencent's shipped Arctic Penguin T800 client; the client's source was never published
admission.a2_quote: QQ 宠物跨平台复刻（Windows / macOS / Linux / Android / HarmonyOS / iOS），基于 Arctic Penguin T800 逆向重建。Flash 内容由 Ruffle 播放。
admission.a3: src/ 135 TypeScript files plus ios/, android/ and harmony/ clients, and resources/ content; no gitlinks in the tree

desc.en: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, rebuilt from an AI-assisted decompilation of the published npm bundle, mirroring its agent loop, tools, MCP transports and permission modes
desc.zh: 对已发布的 npm 包做 AI 辅助反编译后重建的 Anthropic Claude Code 终端代理，复刻其 agent 循环、工具、MCP 传输与权限模式

note.en: The repository holds two descriptions of itself at once: head#118 says the rebuild is informed by ruDevolution's decompilation of the published npm package, while a later line insists it is clean-room with no leaked source. Its own link list calls the remainder a path to 100%, and the decompiler is a submodule (ruvnet/rudevolution), not part of this tree.
note.zh: 这个仓库同时给了两种自我描述：一处说重建依据的是 ruDevolution 对已发布 npm 包的反编译，另一处又强调是不含泄漏源码的净室实现。它自己的链接列表把剩余部分称作「通往 100% 的路径」，而反编译器是子模块（ruvnet/rudevolution），不在本仓库树内。

admission.a1: Anthropic ships Claude Code as a published npm bundle; its GitHub repository (anthropics/claude-code, read 2026-10-17) has no CLI source at its root — .claude-plugin, examples, mods, plugins, scripts and CHANGELOG.md only — so the implementation the candidate rebuilds has not been released by the rights holder.
admission.a2_quote: Open Claude Code is a ground-up open source rebuild of Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, informed by ruDevolution's AI-powered decompilation of the published npm package.
admission.a3: 549 paths, 84 .ts and 47 .js: v2/src holds the rebuild's own architecture directories (agents, tools, mcp, permissions, hooks, config, auth, telemetry, plugins, skills, ui) around index.mjs, and archive/open_claude_code holds a full earlier attempt with cli.mjs and src/ — the reconstruction is in the linked repository, while the decompiler itself is a submodule.

desc.en: FL Studio Mobile, rebuilt clean-room in Rust with browser and Android builds, opening FL Studio Mobile's .flm demo projects
desc.zh: 净室用 Rust 重写的 FL Studio Mobile，有浏览器与 Android 构建，可打开 FL Studio Mobile 的 .flm 演示工程

note.en: Its own status: the first port supports playback and songs saved inside the app, while microphone recording, MIDI devices and Android file import/export are not available yet — and sounds and presets import from a copy of the app the reader owns.
note.zh: 它自己写的进度：首个移植支持播放与应用内保存歌曲，麦克风录音、MIDI 设备与 Android 文件导入导出还没做好；音色与预设要从使用者自己拥有的那份应用里导入。

admission.a1: FL Studio Mobile is Image-Line's shipped commercial app, whose source Image-Line has not released; the README states in its own words that Honeydew is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Image-Line, and ships THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the free instrument libraries it links.
admission.a2_quote: Honeydew is a clean-room reimplementation.
admission.a3: 924 paths, 528 .rs under crates/ and src/, with build.rs, Trunk.toml and an android/ directory producing the browser and APK builds its README documents — the reconstruction is in the linked repository.

desc.en: Tactics Ogre: Let Us Cling Together on PSP and its remaster Tactics Ogre: Reborn: format libraries with unpackers and exporters for the .pac and .pakd archives, the compiled .xlc spreadsheet tables, screenplay and event files and images, plus a cutscene script disassembler
desc.zh: PSP 版 Tactics Ogre: Let Us Cling Together 与其复刻版 Tactics Ogre: Reborn 的数据格式：.pac/.pakd 归档、编译后的 .xlc 表格、剧本与事件文件以及图像的解包与导出库，另附过场脚本反汇编器

admission.a1: Both builds were shipped by the rights holder and no source exists publicly; the repository's own material is the read of the game's data structures.
admission.a2_quote: * [`DisassembleScript`](projects/Gibbed.TacticsOgre.DisassembleScript): A cutscene script disassembler (`.script`). For research purposes.
admission.a3: 152 .cs in projects/, 53 of them in the …FileFormats libraries, plus docs/ holding the opcode and text-encoding tables (cutscene_scripting/psp_natives.md, text_encoding/psp_codepoints_EN.md); asset-like files in the tree: 0.

desc.en: Ambermoon, Amiga → Windows, Linux, macOS and Android, full rewrite in C# with the original data formats reimplemented in its Ambermoon.Data projects, played on the game files the reader obtains itself
desc.zh: Ambermoon，Amiga → Windows、Linux、macOS 与 Android，以 C# 全量重写，原版数据格式在 Ambermoon.Data 各工程里重实现，运行需读者自备原版游戏文件

admission.a1: Ambermoon shipped for the Amiga and its source was never released; what the README links is the data — "If you are interested in the original Amiga game files you can find them here: https://github.com/Pyrdacor/Ambermoon" (head#18) — game files and patches, not code.
admission.a2_quote: Ambermoon.net is a full C# rewrite of Ambermoon and will run at least on Windows, Linux and Mac.
admission.a3: 623 .cs across Ambermoon.Core, Amber.Game, Amber.Abstractions, the Frontend and the Ambermoon.Data.Legacy / .FileSystems readers; the 171 asset-like paths are AmbermoonAndroid icons and screenshots.

desc.en: Skool Daze (Microsphere, 1984) and Back to Skool (1985), Sinclair ZX Spectrum → any platform Python runs on, re-implementation in Python and Pygame with the schools, characters and behaviour rebuilt in its own source
desc.zh: Skool Daze（Microsphere，1984）与 Back to Skool（1985），Sinclair ZX Spectrum → 任何跑得动 Python 的平台，以 Python 与 Pygame 重写，学校、人物与行为都在它自己的源码里重建

admission.a1: Both titles were published by Microsphere for the ZX Spectrum in 1984 and 1985 and no source was released; the reconstruction is of the games as played, and its README describes the published originals before stating its own method.
admission.a2_quote: Pyskool is a re-implementation of these classic games in Python and Pygame,
admission.a3: 67 .py files including pyskool.py and the launcher scripts, plus tests/ and a sphinx man/ docs site; asset-like files in the tree: 0 — the launcher scripts, images, ini and sound files are generated from the repo's own content by `make scripts images ini sounds` (head#23-25).
